enchantments.tooltip: Strength +9: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +9 Enhancement bonus to Strength.
Shatter +11: This effect gives a +11 Enhancement bonus to the DC to resist the character's Sunder and Improved Sunder attempts.
Melee Alacrity 15%: Gain 15% Enhancement bonus to Melee attack speed. Does not stack with the Haste spell.
Insightful Seeker +4: Provides a +4 Insight bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +4 Insight bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).

Relentless Fury: While this item is equipped, any killing blows you strike against enemies may drive you into a furious rage, providing a 5% Enhancement damage bonus to your melee, ranged and unarmed attacks for 30 seconds. Slaying weaker opponents has a reduced chance of producing this effect.
